english_translation: Which car do you want to buy, the red one or the black one?
grammar_notes: Concordial Agreement (Zvivakashure): Notice how 'Ndeipi' establishes the noun class/subject frame (Mupanda 5/9 Nominal or Verbal Stem).
Agglutinative Morphology: 'nhema' combines prefixal/suffixal morphemes (Ø- (Cl. 5/9) + -nhema (root)) with tone contour H-L.
Penultimate Lengthening: In Zezuru declarative sentences, the second-to-last syllable of the phrase carries natural vowel lengthening.
cultural_notes: In Harare Zezuru standard speech, speakers maintain strict alliterative concord (zvivakashure) across noun classes while using respectful plural forms (hunhu).
